687.notes: Atari ST floppy image, FAT12 boot sector (BPB) per reference block; verified: 512/2/1/2/112/1600/0xF9/5/10/2/0 and total_sectors*512 == file size 819200.

689.notes: STDF V4 File Attributes Record (FAR), mandatory first record: REC_LEN U2, REC_TYP U1=0, REC_SUB U1=10, CPU_TYPE U1=2 (Intel x86, little-endian), STDF_VER U1=4. Verified against sample (02 00 00 0a 02 04) and the next record parses as MIR (len 140, type 1, sub 10); STDF spec confirms FAR field order. Only the first record is fixed; later records are variable-length.

777.notes: Virtual floppy disk image, FAT12 boot sector (BPB + extended BPB) per reference block; verified: jump EB3C90, OEM 'DOSVMADD', 512/1/1/2/224/2880/0xF0/9/18/2, label 'NO NAME    ', type 'FAT12   ', boot signature 0xAA55, and total_sectors_16*512 == file size 1474560.

780.notes: Sparse VMDK header per reference block; verified: magic 0x564D444B, version 1, flags 3, capacity 2097152 sectors, grain 128, descriptor at sector 1 (text there reads '# Disk DescriptorFile'), numGTEsPerGT 512, end-line chars 0A/20/0D/0A, compress 0. Applies to sparse (binary) VMDKs only; text-descriptor VMDKs have no such header.

784.notes: Valve Pak (VPK) v2 header per reference block; verified: signature 0x55AA1234, version 2, tree_size 241, sections sum exactly to file size (28+241+66166+0+48+0=66483), tree starts with 'wav'. The four extra size fields exist only for version 2; a v1 file would have only the first three fields.

816.notes: Windows Metafile with placeable header (key 0x9AC6CDD7) + standard 18-byte header per reference block; verified: bbox -1134/-1213/634/744, inch 1000, placeable checksum 0x54BA equals XOR of first 10 words, file_type 1, header_size 9, version 0x0300, file_size 19711 words with file_size*2+22 == file size 39444, num_objects 6, max_record 434. A WMF without the placeable header would start at the standard header instead.

817.notes: ASF Header Object (WMV) per reference block; verified: GUID 75B22630-668E-11CF-A6D9-00AA0062CE6C, object_size 913 (< file size), num_header_objects 6, reserved bytes 0x01/0x02 per ASF spec. Only the top-level Header Object is fixed; its sub-objects are variable.

823.notes: Wii U homebrew bundle; the reference block's IVFC parse is wrong (sample starts 'WUHB', not 'IVFC'). Real header derived from and verified against the sample, all big-endian: magic 'WUHB', header_size 80 (= 4+4+9*8, the header byte length), four (offset,size) u64 pairs that tile the trailing table region exactly to EOF (795528+20=795548, +104=795652, +12=795664, +128=795792), and rpx_offset 512 pointing at the ELF magic of root.rpx. Section identities are not labelled (offsets/sizes only); no published WUHB header spec was found in 2 web searches.
